Here is a detailed description of the video segment:

The segment opens with a frame containing the text "Strategic Planning using Research & Analysis," emphasizing the video's topic. Below it is "Qualitative & Quantitative" pointing to the right with an arrow, and to the right of it there is a large magnifying glass with the word "RESEARCH" inside. Then the screen transitions to a scene with an arrow-shaped signpost pointing in opposite directions, labeled "THIS WAY?" and "THAT WAY?", topped by a magnifying glass with "RESEARCH" inside. Below it, a diverse group of people stands waiting. The camera zooms in, revealing a woman in a yellow top and black skirt holding papers and speaking to a black man with a clipboard, who is speaking back to her. Superimposed magnifying glasses focus on both people and the crowd, suggesting analysis and investigation. Further text appears inside the magnifying glass: "QUALITATIVE &/OR QUANTITATIVE DATA". Finally, the segment transitions again to a white background with the text "Qualitative & Quantitative Research" and the subtitle "Learning goals for this video:", all accompanied by a magnifying glass. The overall style is a whiteboard animation with hand-drawn elements.

The video segment presents a whiteboard-style animation explaining the learning goals of the video. The title of the presentation, "Qualitative & Quantitative Research," is displayed in bold, followed by the text "Learning goals for this video:". The whiteboard then focuses on a hand drawing the text of the two learning goals of the video. The first goal is illustrated with an academic graduation cap icon, followed by the text "What is the connection? Research, Analysis, Strategic Planning". The second goal is illustrated with an academic graduation cap icon, followed by the text "Qualitative & Quantitative Research / Data - WHAT? - WHY? (pros & cons) - HOW?" To the right of the title, a magnifying glass icon zooms in on the word “RESEARCH”. The background remains white, and a watermark for "VideoScribe" is visible in the bottom right corner. The video ends after the hand finishes drawing the content on the whiteboard.

The video segment presents an animated explanation of strategic planning using research and analysis. It begins with a signpost asking "THIS WAY?" and "THAT WAY?". A hand uses a black pen to write "Strategic Planning using Research & Analysis" along the top of the frame. The words "Research & Analysis" are underlined with a red crayon. The frame then transitions to a rectangle. Inside that rectangle, a green pen writes "Secondary & Primary Research". This is followed by a blue pen writing "Qualitative & Quantitative Research" below. Then a red pen writes "Data Quality - Validity & Reliability". Animated diagrams of documents and a magnifying glass are included. Then the rectangle opens into two sections, labeled with green pen as "EXTERNAL" and "INTERNAL". Inside the "INTERNAL" section are animated diagrams of a building, a calculator, gears, and an arm flexing to indicate strength, with the word "ETC." written below with a black pen. In the "EXTERNAL" section, the diagram is filled with a map of the UK, followed by black pen writing "PEST", a graphic of a tower with the number five, along with text "PORTER'S 5" written. Castles are then added as representations of competitors, followed by the text "COMPETITORS". Then "ETC." is added to the bottom. Lastly, the animation transitions to a graphic of a 4-section grid, with an arrow labeled "SUMMARIZE" moving towards it. Throughout the segment, a black magnifying glass icon labeled "RESEARCH" floats in the top right corner. All of these visuals are set against a plain white background and done in a clean, hand-drawn style. The transition happens in a way that is dynamic and creative. The "VideoScribe" logo is at the bottom right of the frame.

Okay! Here is a description of the video segment:

The video segment is a whiteboard animation addressing how The French Cafe can find out what its customers want. On the left side of the screen, there is a cartoon drawing of the French Cafe building with windows and tables outside. The scene depicts several cartoon images representing Qualitative Research, including a group discussion, a one-on-one interview, and a man observing customer behavior. On the right side, a hand uses an orange crayon to write “CHARACTERISTICS” as the title of a section on the whiteboard. The animation then switches to a hand with a black pen that adds bullet points to the list of characteristics, noting "OPEN-ENDED QUESTIONS" and underneath it the words: "WHAT, HOW, WHEN…" (What, how, when…). Next, the pen adds "CAN'T BE QUANTIFIED (COUNTED)" (Can't be quantified (counted)), followed by "UNCOVERS MOTIVATIONS, FEELINGS, PREFERENCES…" (Uncovers motivations, feelings, preferences…), "UNCOVERS IN-DEPTH INFO, RELATIVELY LOW-COST" (Uncovers in-depth information, relatively low-cost), and "NOT REPRESENTATIVE, INTERPRETATION SUBJECTIVE" (Not representative, interpretation subjective). An animated magnifying glass with the word “RESEARCH” (Research) is visible in the upper right of the screen. The video segment aims to explain the characteristics of qualitative data in the context of a business case for the French Cafe.

The video segment illustrates “Quantitative Research” through the example of “The French Cafe,” as written on the front of a sketched, two-story building with an awning. A magnifying glass with the word “Research” inside is seen next to the title. To demonstrate quantitative research methods, the video illustrates the different tools. It displays a clipboard with several tick boxes marked, representing a questionnaire, and captions that this is “A set of answer options to choose between.” Then, a cupcake with a cherry on top materializes, labeled “New,” and the video states that this is an example of experimentation as the video asks the question: “How many new cakes sold?” Next, a pair of glasses appear, representing observations as the video asks the question: “How many enter/walk past?” A cartoon female character with dark skin, dressed in a white shirt and black skirt, is standing by a menu next to the cafe. Underneath, a "www" followed by "Google Analytics" shows how online booking can be measured. Finally, the scene fades into a plain white background.
